tasks.build: cd front-end && PATH="$PWD/../node_modules/.bin:$PATH" deno task build

test:unit.description: parallel: backend `deno test --parallel` on its unit files, then jest on jest/unit (parallel by default) — REQ-278/316, see scripts/gate-lane.ts

test:int.description: parallel: backend `deno test --parallel` on its int.test.ts + e2e.test.ts (in-process servers, nothing to serve) — see scripts/gate-lane.ts

test:e2e.description: parallel: the lane runs alongside unit and int against the served BASE_URL; inside it jest/integration (parallel by default) then cypress, whose specs run one browser at a time (Cypress has no workers outside Cypress Cloud) — see scripts/gate-lane.ts
